g.inkscape:label: Panel A uses the frozen 5,000-resample C3–N0 spatial analysis. Panels B–C summarize an exploratory Bayesian temporal analysis based on 15 comparisons across 12 cells; the shaded band is a credible interval for the mean response, not a predi
g.text: Panel A uses the frozen 5,000-resample C3–N0 spatial analysis. Panels B–C summarize an exploratory Bayesian temporal analysis based on 15 comparisons across 12 cells; the shaded band is a credible interval for the mean response, not a prediction interval.
